t: The Wrapper Shim: Refactoring a Live Python Monolith with an AI Architect
s: This article details a novel approach to refactoring a live, build-free Python monolith using an AI architect, focusing on managing the risks of live-reloading development environments and circular dependencies through 'airtight' prompt contracts and a 'wrapper shim' strategy. It proposes a new model for human-AI collaboration where AI assists from the command line, not the editor, to maintain system stability and facilitate complex architectural changes.
sub: Live-reloading development environments and error catastrophic failure
Human-AI collaboration models for complex refactoring
Wrapper shim strategy for managing AI-driven code edits
Airtight prompt contracts and command-line AI interaction
Refactoring monolithic Python applications with AI assistance
